answer: A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 12 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a haven bet on surviving 106 epochs of grading, and every jetty settlement recomputes the zephyr schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 106 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 22 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
